admin / user roles)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="175" x="255" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="hash" style="rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;" target="users"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sess" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" value="Session Token Manager
